name: 9k

fonts.arabic: Thmanyah Sans, IBM Plex Sans Arabic

rules:
Calm, precise, typed, and a little playful in the details. 9k is not flashy.

- Green #166434 is the brand: bands, primary buttons, solid badges, Nino's body.
- Orange #E85A02 is the accent and gets ONE hit per shot: an underline, the caret, a highlight, a key number. Text on orange is black, never white.
- The glow (green → amber → orange, half off-screen, drifting) is the only gradient allowed. Never behind small text.
- Type: IBM Plex Sans 700 for headlines, Plex Serif for the one editorial line, Plex Mono for code, numbers in UI and the wordmark. Arabic: Thmanyah, falling back to IBM Plex Sans Arabic; RTL mirrors the layout.
- Text is typed, not faded in. Every film types at least one key line.
- Motion has weight but doesn't bounce. Only Nino is allowed a visible bounce. Nino is whole pixels only: never blurred, rotated or smoothed. On the green band his body turns white.
- Something new every 2–4 seconds; no beat sits dead for more than 4.
- Never: Inter, Roboto, Poppins, Space Grotesk or system fonts; a violet or teal accent; gradients other than the glow; bouncy or elastic easing on text; everything fading in; neon, lens flares, particle bursts; more than one accent colour in a shot.
